seoTitle: Dog Age in Human Years Calculator
metaDescription: Convert a dog's age to human years with the 2020 epigenetic formula (16 x ln(age) + 31), the size-based rule and the old 7x rule, and see its life stage.
intro: See how old your dog is in human terms, with three different methods.
why:
The 2020 UCSD formula comes from DNA-methylation research on Labrador retrievers: human age = 16 ln(dog age) + 31 for dogs over a year old. The size-based rule counts 15 human years for the first year, 9 for the second and 4, 5 or 6 per year after that for small, medium and large dogs. The 7x rule is shown for comparison. A life stage label (puppy, young adult, adult, senior, geriatric) is added.

No formula is correct for every dog, because breeds age at different rates. Use it for fun and ask a vet about senior care.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Enter the dog's age in years and months.
Talk to your vet about age-appropriate care.

faq.a: Each method is a model. The 2020 formula is research-based but derived from one breed.

faq.q: When is a dog a senior?
faq.a: Around 7 years, earlier for giant breeds.
